load_error_generic: Something went wrong loading this page's data. Please refresh, or try again shortly.
signup_notice: This form exists only for the one-time admin-bootstrap step: the first person to sign up here has their account promoted to admin via a documented one-time SQL statement. Every teacher account after that is created by the admin from the Teachers screen, not through this form.
signup_error_password_length: Password must be at least 6 characters.
signup_error_duplicate: An account with this email already exists.
home_teacher_subtitle: You're signed in as a teacher.
home_just_signed_up: Account created. If this is meant to be the first admin account, ask whoever has database access to run the documented admin-bootstrap SQL statement, then sign in again.
classes_code_generation_failed: Could not generate a unique class code after several attempts. Please try again.
teachers_need_class_first: Create at least one class first, then come back here to assign a teacher.
teachers_error_class_required: Assign the teacher to at least one class.
teachers_error_duplicate: A teacher with this email already exists.
teachers_error_create_failed: Could not create the teacher account.
teachers_error_assign_failed: Teacher account created, but class assignment failed: {message}. Assign classes manually.
teachers_created_success: Teacher account created for {email}. One-time temporary password (share it with them directly — it will not be shown again): {password}
teacher_no_classes: You haven't been assigned to any classes yet. Ask the admin to assign you to a class.
teacher_no_roster_note: No students yet — roster tracking arrives in a later story.
join_error_invalid_code: No class has that code. Check it with your teacher.
join_name_note: You can choose a nickname later, once you're approved.
join_consent_notice: We store your name, class, and progress so your teacher can track it. Nothing is shown publicly, and you can ask for it to be deleted at any time.
join_consent_checkbox_label: I am the parent or guardian, and I consent to this.
join_error_missing_fields: Something's missing — go back and check every step.
join_error_consent_required: Guardian consent is required to continue.
join_error_duplicate: A registration for this name and class is already pending or was recently rejected. Ask your teacher, or wait for it to be cleared.
join_error_generic: Something went wrong submitting your registration. Please try again.
join_pending_explanation: Your class teacher (or the admin, as backup) reviews new registrations. You'll be able to sign in once you're approved.
join_pending_cannot_yet: Until then, you won't appear on any roster or leaderboard, and you can't log homework.
requests_admin_subtitle: Every class's pending registrations. Normally the class's own teacher acts on these — this is the backup path.
requests_teacher_subtitle: Pending registrations for your assigned classes.
requests_empty_body: New self-registrations for your classes will appear here.
requests_no_teams_note: Create at least one team before approving a student — see Manage Teams.
requests_outcome_approved: {name} was approved and assigned a team. One-time sign-in — share it directly, it will not be shown again: username {username}, PIN {pin}.
requests_outcome_rejected: {name} was rejected. They will not appear on any roster.
requests_error_not_found: That request could not be found — it may already have been decided.
requests_error_approve_failed: Could not approve this student. Please try again.
requests_error_approve_partial: Sign-in credentials were created (username {username}, PIN {pin}) but the approval record failed to save — please try again.
requests_error_reject_failed: Could not reject this student. Please try again.
requests_error_clear_failed: Could not clear this rejected registration. Please try again.
